sections.title: UNITS
sections.body: Every operator belongs to one unit. You pick it during verification and can switch any time with `/unit`.

sections.title: ⚔️  GROUND UNIT
sections.body: The main assault force. Fireteams, breaching, holding ground. Most operators are here, and most new joins should start here.

sections.title: 🎯  SNIPER UNIT
sections.body: Overwatch, recon and long range support. Works in pairs, reports to the op lead, and opens the fight from where nobody is looking.

sections.title: 👕  UNIFORM
sections.body:
**Black outfit, everybody, every op.** That is the whole kit rule for now.

It is not decoration. It is how you tell ROC from the other side at a glance, and it is why the footage looks like one unit instead of a queue of random avatars. Sort it before your first op rather than in the lobby.

sections.title: SPECIALISATIONS
sections.body: These stack on top of your unit and your rank. Ask an NCO or Command for one.

fields.name: Primary Pilot and Reserve Pilot
fields.value: Transport, insertion and air support. Reserve flies when Primary is not on.

fields.name: Medic
fields.value: Keeps the unit in the fight. Patches people up, and calls the extraction when patching isn't enough.

fields.name: JTAC
fields.value: The ground operator who talks to the pilots and calls the air in. Air support only works with one.
